 Filing: Alibaba says its chip design unit T-Head filed on September 11 for a Hong Kong listing after exchange clearance; T-Head is set to remain a subsidiary   —  Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.'s in-house chip design unit T-Head has filed for a Hong Kong listing, moving ahead with a proposed spin-off …
